{{Top|leg}}
'''Solid fuel-concentrate slugs''' were a type of [[Fuel slug/Legends|fuel slug]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]].<ref name="EP1CROSS">''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Unconventional and expensive to manufacture, solid fuel concentrate slugs burned furiously when ignited, and could be vectored electromagnetically for steering. This allowed for immense speed and maneuverability, while maintaining minimal engine mass; a solid fuel system limited flight time, which necessitated droids being periodically cycled between refueling and deployment.<ref name="EP1CROSS" />
